rationale.overall: B reads much closer to the REFERENCE's glossy, three-dimensional object sitting on a warm ivory plate, whereas A is a flat vector wedge chart with only a faint sheen.
rationale.material: B has the rounded tube cross-section, specular top-edge highlight, soft contact shadow and translucent depth the REFERENCE shows; A's arc is a flat fill with a thin rim and no volume.
rationale.silhouette: A's arc terminals are crisper and the orange wedge is a cleaner, more legible shape, while B's wedge is muddied by its own reflections and its terminals blur into the background.
rationale.smallsize: A holds a harder, higher-contrast ring and a distinct orange mark at 32px and 16px, whereas B's softer gradients and lighter navy lose edge definition and the wedge starts to smear.
